DISCHARGE SUMMARY (SYNTHETIC RECORD)
PATIENT: Eleanor Vance [SYNTHETIC]
DOB: 1952-08-14 | MRN: SYNTH-MRN-84920
ADMIT DATE: 2026-10-14 | DISCHARGE DATE: 2026-10-20

HOSPITAL COURSE:
Patient admitted for acute exacerbation of heart failure. Responded well to intravenous furosemide. Transitioned to oral regimen. Clinically euvolemic and stable for discharge.

DISCHARGE FOLLOW-UP INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Primary Care: Schedule follow-up appointment with primary care physician Dr. Sarah Jenkins within 7 days of discharge (by 2026-10-27).
2. Cardiology: Follow up with outpatient cardiology clinic. Patient requires echocardiogram in 4 weeks.
3. Laboratory: Order basic metabolic panel (BMP) in 10-14 days to monitor renal function after furosemide adjustment.
4. Medication Reconciliation: Medication reconciliation reviewed with patient and daughter at bedside prior to discharge.
